ScopeName.description: A drawing's scope as `analysis.drawings` names it.

oneOf.description: Every chart of the drawing's market, at any timeframe.
Only the chart it is on, at the bars that chart is cut to.

pane_id.description:
The pane holding the drawing on that tab, as `analysis.drawings`
lists it. A drawing id is unique only within its pane.

tab_id.description: The tab holding the drawing, as `analysis.drawings` lists it.
